definitions.gloss: first ten days of the month, early part of the month
definitions.explanation: The period from the 1st to the 10th of a month. Part of the traditional Japanese system of dividing each month into three roughly equal periods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧{上旬|じょうじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms bloom in early April.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{上旬|じょうじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: The product is expected to arrive in the first part of next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{十一月|じゅういちがつ}→十一月：00635_juuichigatsu⟧{上旬|じょうじゅん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見頃|みごろ}→見頃：16868_migoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The autumn leaves reach their peak from early to mid-November.

notes:
USAGE:
Japanese divides each month into three periods:
- {上旬|じょうじゅん}: days 1-10 (early)
- ⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧: days 11-20 (middle)
- ⟦{下旬|げじゅん}→下旬：00062_gejun⟧: days 21-end (late)

This system is commonly used in business, weather forecasts, shipping estimates, and seasonal descriptions. More precise than saying ⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧ (beginning) and very common in everyday Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧{上旬|じょうじゅん}: early [month]
- {上旬|じょうじゅん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧: from early to mid-month
- {上旬|じょうじゅん}ごろ: around the beginning of the month
